rationale: Recorded the current account for receipt 5cb138c50c7241b6a2e9f6c7a8698550, which exercises the vote path: the restarted instance whose reconstruction was empty granted the vote to a peer that holds no vote in the configuration entry of its own log and persisted that vote (comparison 0 violated, valid witness at parsed index 32: granted true, responder_config_voters 0 against log_config_voters 2, logged vote term 3 with the candidate's id), while the flag-disabled control refused the identical request (comparison 1 holds at parsed index 34: granted false, no vote persisted). Added a fact for that grant, cited the receipt in the guarded gate behaviour, and marked the question explained for the exercised scope while naming the one consequence that remains unexecuted.

investigations.discriminator: Whether an acknowledged commit that rested on a minority of the committed configuration is actually discarded once a majority that never held it forms new leadership in a higher term (needs a committed configuration of five or more voters so such a majority exists while the holder is down); the other boundaries are recorded as limitations, not open questions.

knowledge.statement: With an empty reconstructed configuration both vote handlers skip their membership and voter rejections: requestVote rejects a candidate absent from the configuration only when len(r.configurations.latest.Servers) > 0 and rejects a candidate without a vote under the same guard, and requestPreVote repeats both guards, so a node holding no servers performs neither check and can grant support to a peer that is neither a member nor a voter of the committed configuration.
knowledge.conditions: The node's configurations.latest is empty while the committed configuration recorded in its own log names members; the request passes the term, leader and log up-to-dateness checks that follow the guards; NewRaft reconstruction with RestoreCommittedLogs enabled can produce such an empty configuration at startup.

knowledge.statement: In the retained vote-path execution the restarted instance acted on support the committed configuration does not sanction: with an empty reconstructed configuration (responder_config_voters 0 against the two voters recorded at index 103 in its own log) it granted a real vote request from a peer that is a member but holds no vote, moving its term from 2 to 3, answering granted true and persisting the vote for that peer at term 3; the same request against the flag-disabled restart of the same instance, which held the configuration entry's own voter count, was refused with granted false and no vote overwritten.
knowledge.conditions: Three-member cluster with one peer demoted to a nonvoter that keeps receiving entries; the responder is restarted alone with no snapshot of its own and is reconnected to the two live peers before the leader is stopped so that it knows no leader; the request carries the demoted peer's real identity, address and last log entry and claims a term one above the responder's; no responder state is fabricated.

interpretations.rationale: Receipt 5cb138c50c7241b6a2e9f6c7a8698550 (completed, exit 0, TestAssuranceRestoreCommittedLogsContext passed, 35 parsed events) completes the exercised picture on the vote path. Comparison 0 is violated with a valid witness at parsed index 32: after the leader was stopped, the restarted instance whose reconstructed configuration held no servers granted a real vote request from a peer that is a member of the committed configuration but has no vote in it (candidate_has_vote false in the inputs event at parsed index 31, snapshot_count 0), raising its term from 2 to 3, answering granted true and persisting the vote for that peer at term 3 (logged_vote_term_after 3 with the candidate's id, where it had held term 2 before). Comparison 1 holds at parsed index 34: the same request against the same instance restarted with the flag disabled, holding the two-voter configuration from its own log, was refused with granted false and no vote written. The mechanism is the guarded gate recorded in @empty_config_vote_gate: both rejections are skipped when the reconstructed configuration has no servers, so the node's support is not bound to any committed membership [vote_gates, prevote_gates]. Together with the previously recorded receipts this closes the question for the exercised scope: the reconstruction diverges in both directions and across three ladders from a skipped configuration entry [scan_start, restore_lastapplied, cfg_entry]; the resulting context then (i) leaves a node permanently unable to campaign or contending for a quorum it can never reach (bounded non-progress, receipts 63d4401225884bdd9c75fbe580336c63 and faa52ef8ac8a422aa26e12582959eda1), (ii) lets a node acquire leadership and commit with support from a minority of the committed configuration, including a client-acknowledged commit that exists on one of three committed voters (receipts faa52ef8ac8a422aa26e12582959eda1 and c7938884cd87410eb02432e32dc092ce), (iii) persists under a live healthy leader until a configuration entry is appended, and is repaired by such an entry (receipt a1c98fc2bafd4775aa05275dd25f2767), and (iv) grants and durably records a vote for a peer that holds no vote in the committed configuration (this receipt). One consequence remains unexecuted and is not claimed: whether an acknowledged entry that rests on a minority is discarded once a majority that never held it forms higher-term leadership, which needs a committed configuration of five or more voters. The exercised scope remains a single process with in-memory stores and no crash injection.
counterevidence: The feature's documented purpose is replaying known-committed logs into the FSM; nothing in the sources makes skipping committed configuration entries a required behaviour, and the existing TestRaft_RestoreCommittedLogs asserts only applied index, tracked commit index and log indices, so it neither exercises nor contradicts the configuration reconstruction.

Competing explanation that the flag's committed-log replay itself, rather than the skipped configuration entry, produces these effects: excluded wherever tested, by the within-flag case whose configuration entry lies above the replayed prefix and by the flag-disabled controls in every receipt, which hold the published configuration and refuse the same requests and decisions.

Scope of the vote-path result: the request's campaign decision and its claim of a term one above the responder's are synthesized (the peer's own identity, address and log are real), so the receipt establishes that such a request is granted rather than that the peer campaigned on its own; the pre-vote handler was not exercised and only shares the same guards by source inspection.

The empty reconstruction in this receipt came from a restart with no snapshot of the node's own; the vote gate behaviour is therefore established for that path, not for every reconstruction the feature can produce.
limitations: Single process with in-memory stores, no crash injection and no disk-backed commit-tracking store.
The acknowledged-commit discard consequence and five-or-more-voter configurations are unexercised; the entry known to rest on one copy is not shown to be erased.
Windows remain single-shot (200 ms after stopping the leader here, 400 ms for the live-cluster observation, 3000 ms for leadership, 1000-1500 ms for commits).
Only one restarted instance and one delivered request are exercised per vote-path case, and pre-vote requests, multiple concurrent candidates and membership changes during the window are not covered.
